Public saunas in San Diego, CA

San Diego's walk-in and drop-in options are mostly Korean-style: two gender-separated bathhouses a few blocks apart on Convoy Street in Kearny Mesa, and a co-ed heated-room and cold-plunge center in Hillcrest. For a wood-fired sauna, Beach Sauna runs weekend public sessions on South Ponto Beach in Encinitas, about 25 miles north of downtown. Scandinavian Heat Club at Ocean Beach's Barnes Tennis Center was still listed as opening soon on 2026-11-25, and mobile operators such as Go Banya and Roam run occasional pop-up public sessions.

4 venues, each checked against the venue's own website on 2026-11-25. Fields we could not confirm are marked Unknown. Prices and hours change, so confirm before you go.

Yu Spa

Kearny Mesa (Convoy Street) · 3927 Convoy St, San Diego, CA 92111
BathhouseSteam room
Drop-in price
$45 sauna admission; $55 sauna + jjimjilbang; 10-ticket bundles $350 / $450
Session length
2 hours (sauna admission); 3 hours (sauna + jjimjilbang)
Cold plunge
Cold tubs in the men's and women's sections, plus a shared ice room with jjimjilbang admission
Schedule / who
Mon, Wed, Thu and Sun 9:30am-8:30pm; Fri-Sat 9:30am-9pm; closed Tuesday. Reservations required for admission. Wet areas are gender-separated and clothing-free (no bathing suits); the common area with red clay and Himalayan salt saunas, ice room and rest area is shared and requires the provided uniform. No children under 13; ages 13-17 only with a same-gender parent or guardian.
Notes
Sauna admission covers showers, hot and cold tubs, and dry and steam saunas; jjimjilbang admission adds the red clay sauna, Himalayan salt sauna, ice room, common rest area and uniform. Body scrubs and massages include sauna and jjimjilbang admission. Shower before using the tubs. No footwear past the lobby; phones not allowed in locker or wet areas. Sauna temperatures Unknown.

Daily 8:30am-9pm. Traditional Korean sauna, completely separated between men and women; bathing suits not allowed. Minors 13-17 must be with a same-gender parent or guardian and have a signed consent form. Reservation requirement for entry Unknown (appointment page is for treatments).

Entrance covers the hot jacuzzi, cold pool, and steam and dry saunas; men's side adds a sleep room, women's side a Himalayan salt and red clay room. Body scrub $85 for 30 minutes (entrance included with treatments). No water on the dry sauna rocks. Phones not allowed in the spa or locker rooms. 4-hour free parking with validation. Karma Wellness

Hillcrest (1st Avenue) · 3969 1st Avenue, San Diego, CA 92103

Cold plunges and a cold room (Wellness Center page lists jacuzzis, cold plunges and steam room as now open; the FAQ still calls them coming soon)
Schedule / who
Wellness Center open daily 10am-9pm, last entry 8pm. Co-ed throughout; provided uniform (shorts and t-shirt) with underwear on; bathing suit for the steam room and cold plunge. Membership not required.
Notes
Self-guided circuit of themed rooms: Forest Room, Himalayan Salt Room, Mugwort sauna, Mineral Clay Room, Cold Room and Red Light room, plus jacuzzis, steam room and cold plunges. Heat source and temperatures Unknown. Rooms are social, not silent; phones allowed. Showers and towels provided. On-site parking. Massages and facials sold separately.
